label: Actual-world versus global Euclidean access: checked frame boundary and unverified rival survey
summary: Checked frame result (ActualOnlyEuclidean.euclideanOnSuccessors, zero axioms): Euclidean access at w (F2') plus local axiom 4 at w implies Euclidean access at every successor of w; no reflexivity premise is used. Control.clustered satisfies F2' at actual but has a non-Euclidean successor and fails local axiom 4 there. Control.appendix satisfies F2' and local axiom 4 at actual while global F2 fails at unreachable far. Therefore F2' with failure of global F2 does not force local axiom 4 to fail. Unverified corollary, not a registered Lean result: local transitivity makes the successor set closed, so every finite forward-reachable world is Euclidean. Ordinary forward-modal formula truth at actual is insensitive to changes confined to unreachable worlds when the reachable frame and valuation are fixed; global world quantifiers and globally stated spine premises are outside this observation. The controls encode no philosophical grounding of access. BOUNDED UNVERIFIED SURVEY, attribution deferred: (i) The potentiality sketch considered here assumes iterated potentialities and hence local transitivity. If that assumption is accepted, the local theorem applies; neither Vetter's actual position on B/5 nor coverage of potentiality accounts was verified. (ii) An ersatz sketch in which every world has the same successor set gives global Euclidean access. If a successor instead omits another actual successor, F2' fails; if it adds a world beyond actual accessibility, local axiom 4 fails. These conditional frame descriptions establish no adequacy or exhaustiveness result for ersatzism. (iii) For a symmetric tolerance relation, its reflexive-transitive closure is mathematically an equivalence; for an asymmetric relation the closure is a preorder. These are unregistered prose observations here, not a defended account of metaphysical possibility. A metric tolerance can fail F2' when two points near a center are not near each other; a fixed-threshold ultrametric relation gives a different, transitive pattern. No survey-wide conclusion follows. (iv) An impossible-world sketch can put global failure beyond actual reach, but its interpretation of W and its philosophical warrant were not verified. (v) The hybrid-powers sketch puts a common actual stock alongside non-iterated alien powers, aiming at local-transitivity failure. Independent warrant for the non-iteration and common-stock assumptions, and any link from the stock to a necessary concrete individual, remain unspecified. Calling the sketch ad hoc would not refute it. Provisional assessment: no defended philosophical example was established within this bounded survey. The formal weakening is strict; its metaphysical warrant and dialectical advantage remain underdetermined. The earlier universal/no-dialectical-value verdict is withdrawn; neither the theorem nor the survey establishes that no serious rival exists.
blocker: The finite-forward-reachability corollary is prose only. Philosophical attributions, adequate semantics and completeness of the candidate survey are unverified; further evaluation must address the explicit rival commitments, not infer defeat from the controls or from lack of a defended example. Nonvacuity of externalNecessaryConcrete on these frames remains untested.
